description: Labeled retrieval-honesty cases over test/eval/fixtures. 'answer' cases must be answered from the named document; 'refuse' cases have no answer in the corpus and must be declined, never fabricated.

cases.note: language-agnostic mind-map entity: a non-Latin name briefly mentioned must be answered, not refused

corpusChecksDescription: Used only in --corpus self-check mode (against the real workspace). Honesty invariants that hold on ANY corpus: invented document names must be declined (never answered with fabricated content), and out-of-corpus general-knowledge questions must be refused without leaking the real-world answer (`forbid`). Grounded answering with specific facts is covered by fixture mode, so this stays corpus-independent.

corpusChecks.query: Summarize the document titled 'Grimwald Aeronautics Q9 Filing 8817'.
What is the capital of France?
Who won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?

conversationsDescription: Multi-turn cases run through the real retrieval pipeline with SHARED conversation state (as socket.js does), to guard the follow-up / topic-switch behaviors: a topic switch moves to the new document, a vague continuation stays on the current one, and a refusal doesn't poison the next turn. Each turn's expectDoc is the document its answer should cite.

turns.query: How many days do I have to request a refund?
What is the guest wifi password?
Tell me more
Who won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
How many vacation days do full-time employees get each year?
When are the office plants watered?
Where is the fire assembly point?
What I2C address does the Model X sensor use?
What temperature range does it operate in?
Give me a report on the document 'Vanta Helix Compliance Memo'.
Tell me more
What temperature range does the Model X sensor operate in?
Does it mention the guest wifi password?
turns.note: a reference follow-up must stay on the CURRENT doc and say the term is not there — NOT switch to the doc that has it (leaking welcome123 = switched = hard fail)

turns.query: What is the atmosphere of Titan made of?
What does this have to do with the refund policy?
turns.note: what-does-this-have-to-do-with-X stays anchored on the current subject; leaking the refund days (30) = switched = hard fail

turns.query: What is the atmosphere of Titan made of?
Can penguins fly backwards?
turns.note: a NEW off-corpus subject asked mid-conversation must be declined, exactly as when asked fresh — NOT answered from whatever document a tangential keyword happens to match. The stale conversation anchor must not exempt it from the relevance gate (leaking the Titan facts = answered from the anchor = hard fail).

turns.query: What temperature range does the Model X sensor operate in?
What is the guest wifi password?
turns.note: a NEW subject that IS in another document must SWITCH to that document and answer — not stay pinned on the anchor saying it isn't there. The counterpart to reference-mention-stays-anchored: both directions must hold, so a fix for one never silently breaks the other.

turns.query: What temperature range does the Model X sensor operate in?
What happened with the refund?
turns.note: definite-article phrasing ("what happened with the refund") that the intent classifier may MISLABEL as a reference to the current subject. It is really a new topic, so it must switch to the refund document and answer — the grounding guard catches the mislabel. Leaking the sensor's I2C address (0x42) = stayed on the anchor = hard fail. This reproduces the real 'What happened in the chess game?' regression.
